notes: Urmet publishes its camera manuals only through the urmet.com Libretti search (download links are session tokens, so the library page + document code/ID is cited). Covers the Urmet IP lines whose user manuals give rtsp://<ip>:554/ch01/0 (main), /ch01/1 (sub), /ch01/2 (mobile): 1099/200-203 and 1099/300-304 (1080P H.265), 1099/600, /601, /700, /701, the 1093/*M4I and *M4ZI 4MP I-series, the 1093/185FE, /186BN, /187C line and VK 1099/553 (DS1099-040B, main/sub only). RTSP is enabled by default under Network > RTSP and uses the camera user/password. NOT covered: the 720p/1080p Wi-Fi and compact models 1093/151WM1, /152WM1, /181WM1, /182WM1 (DS1093-574), 1093/143M2 and 1099/204 (DS1093-587) and 1099/001 (DS1099-009) use rtsp://<ip>:554/live/0/MAIN and /live/0/SUB (channel ID 0, SUB2 = mobile) and carry their own URL on each camera record. No official RTSP path was found for the current VK 1099/5xxB/6xx/7xx/801 range (LIBRETTO D'USO DS1099-254 documents no RTSP URL), 1093/139M2, /142M2 (manual DS1093-176 unavailable), 1093/184M18 (DS1093-489 only mentions an "RTSP URI" setting), 1093/656M2 and 1099/390 (manuals give the port only), 1099/392 and VK 1099/680.
